summary: A classic mid-century steel passenger coach at standard gauge (1.435 m), 23 m over the body: a lofted body wi… joints door_lf, door_lr, door_rf, door_rr, bogie_f_axle_0, bogie_f_axle_1, …; options livery; sockets socket_coupler_front, socket_coupler_rear, seat_passenger.
